description: Search product catalog. Filter by category (mice|laptops|phones), max_price (INR), min_rating, brand substring.

fields.description: Return only these keys (id,name,price,rating,brand,spec) to cut payload.

limit.description: Max results per call. Omit to return every match.

offset.description: Skip this many matches, for paging.

sort.description: Order results before paging. battery_desc sorts by mAh parsed from spec.

spec_contains.description: Keep only products whose spec or name contains this word (e.g. wireless, gaming, charging).

name: search_products
